insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This field allows for multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment, providing more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking. Developers should review their existing code and update it to take advantage of this new feature. The GraphQL Admin API should be used to access this new field.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed order tracking, allowing them to better manage their fulfillment operations and provide better customer service.
insight.why_it_matters: This change provides more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking, allowing merchants to better manage their fulfillment operations and provide better customer service. It also simplifies the process of importing orders with multiple tracking numbers.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default dev origin. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs. OAuth state values now use cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit. Dependencies have also been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: Create Hydrogen now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
Serve UI extension source maps during app development.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed, simplifying inventory management.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for easier deployment of Hydrogen storefronts.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order management capabilities.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL expansion dominate the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as HTTP/2 support, secure OAuth state values, and recommendations for the Shopify AI Toolkit. The skeleton package was also updated to version 2026.4.6.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants using the existing ShopifyQL infrastructure and the new shop_campaign_insights schema.

actions.text: Update Hydrogen projects to the latest versions of @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen
Explore the new shop_campaign_insights schema in ShopifyQL for Shop Campaigns performance data
